보석과 은신, 도박의 여신 니비 롬보 대즐은 궁극의 큰손으로, 특정한 보석 하나를 대가로 드워프 신 토라그에게서 자신의 신성을 따냈다고 전해집니다. 니비의 도박 사랑은 승리의 쾌감이 아니라 내기 그 자체의 흥분에서 비롯되었으며, 이러한 태도는 결국 그녀를 빚이 매력을 넘어서는 상황으로 몰아넣었습니다. 채권자들보다 한 발 앞서 나아가며, 니비는 지하로, 그리고 다크랜드로 달아났습니다. 빛 없는 땅에서 겪은 그녀의 모험 대부분은 세월과 역사 속에 잊혔지만, 그녀는 끝내 여신으로 다시 태어나 심층 노움의 첫 번째 존재로 칭송받으며 나타났습니다. 심층 노움은 독특한 마법 능력을 지니고, 지루함과 권태에 굴복한 노움의 목숨을 앗아가는 쇠약의 저주인 두려운 창백화에 면역인 기이한 지하 노움입니다.

칭호 회색의 다채로운 자

관장 영역 도박, 보석, 노움, 은신

계율 여행하는 곳마다 벌어지는 운에 맡긴 놀이의 규칙과 전략을 배워라, 위험을 감수하고 그 결과가 좋든 나쁘든 음미하라, 위험 감수의 여파를 처리할 때 폭력 대신 은신과 술책을 써라

금기 내기의 정해진 규칙이나 조건을 어기는 것, 내기의 결과를 피하려 폭력을 쓰는 것

name: Trudd

description.value:
In crafting Trudd as a gift for his beloved, Torag thought of the qualities he'd not given his other children. After a few moments of contemplation, he settled on the simplest and most elusive answer—he had not gifted his wife with a child who bore the strength of the mountains themselves. He was to be his father's strong left hand, acting as the general of Torag's armies when defending Heaven from incursions by demons or other such nefarious forces. Trudd's personal charge was to guard the seat of Forgeheart when the Father of Creation traveled the multiverse. Trudd took to these dual tasks with glee and has been doing his duty ever since.

Trudd is almost unknown outside of dwarven halls, or at least he once was. When the Whispering Tyrant broke free, dwarven Knights of Lastwall began to share his teachings with their fellow knights and compatriots. Trudd's religion is spreading slowly but steadily among humans, half-elves, and even orcs. Trudd doesn't know what to make of this, but overall, he is doing his best to respect his new followers, accepting these new children as a loving adoptive father. He sends omens of warning if a vulnerable target is about to be attacked and blessings of endurance to keep guards awake and on task. In Trudd's mind, almost nothing is as important as guarding his followers and his followers guarding their own charges.

Title The Mighty

Areas of Concern Bravery, defense, strength

Edicts Offer your strength to aid others, protect those weaker than you

Anathema Engage in petty demonstrations of strength, use your strength to take advantage of others

Religious Symbol warhammer in front of a golden shield

Sacred Animal bear

Sacred Colors brown, gray

사랑하는 아내를 위한 선물로 트루드를 빚으면서, 토라그는 다른 자식들에게 주지 못한 자질들을 떠올렸습니다. 잠시 숙고한 끝에, 그는 가장 단순하면서도 가장 붙잡기 어려운 답에 이르렀습니다. 그는 아내에게 산 그 자체의 힘을 지닌 아이를 선물하지 못했던 것입니다. 트루드는 아버지의 강인한 왼손이 되어, 악마나 그와 같은 사악한 세력의 침입으로부터 천상을 지킬 때 토라그 군대의 장군 노릇을 하도록 정해졌습니다. 트루드의 개인적 임무는 창조의 아버지가 다중우주를 여행하는 동안 대장간심장의 옥좌를 지키는 것이었습니다. 트루드는 이 두 가지 임무를 기꺼이 떠맡았으며 그 이후로 줄곧 자신의 소임을 다해 왔습니다.

트루드는 드워프의 전당 밖에서는 거의 알려지지 않았습니다. 적어도 한때는 그랬습니다. 속삭이는 폭군이 풀려났을 때, 라스트월의 드워프 기사들이 동료 기사와 전우들에게 그의 가르침을 전하기 시작했습니다. 트루드의 종교는 인간, 하프엘프, 심지어 오크 사이에서도 더디지만 꾸준히 퍼지고 있습니다. 트루드는 이를 어떻게 받아들여야 할지 알지 못하지만, 대체로 그는 새로운 추종자들을 존중하려 최선을 다하며, 사랑 넘치는 양아버지처럼 이 새로운 아이들을 받아들이고 있습니다. 그는 취약한 대상이 공격받으려 할 때 경고의 전조를 보내고, 경비병들이 깨어 임무에 충실하도록 인내의 축복을 내립니다. 트루드의 마음속에서는, 자신의 추종자들을 지키는 것, 그리고 그 추종자들이 각자의 피후견인을 지키는 것만큼 중요한 일은 거의 없습니다.

칭호 강대한 자

관장 영역 용맹, 방어, 힘

계율 남을 돕기 위해 당신의 힘을 내어주어라, 당신보다 약한 이들을 보호하라

금기 힘을 하찮게 과시하는 것, 당신의 힘을 이용해 남을 착취하는 것

name: Nyarlathotep (The Veiled Voice)

description.value:
Nyarlathotep is a being of a thousand shapes, each of which has a name, such as the Haunter of the Dark or the Veiled Voice. Because he has walked the world in mortal form, Nyarlathotep is unique among the Outer Gods for appearing comprehensible and understandable—but this is a facade. The Crawling Chaos, as he is also known, appears humanlike not because he identifies with mortal concerns or cares for his mortal followers, but because a mortal shape makes it easier for him to do his work: spreading the influence of the Outer Gods.

Title The Veiled Voice

Areas of Concern Dangerous secrets, long-term plans, reckless innovation

Edicts Innovate destructive alchemy or magic, instigate conflict between your enemies, share dangerous secrets

Anathema None

Religious Symbol a pair of runed lips pursed in a whisper

Sacred Animal panther

Sacred Colors black, purple

name: Velgaas

description.value:
Many an idealist with great hopes to change the world has had their dreams realized by meeting a handsome stranger on the road. Velgaas, who might be mistaken for a nagaji with his scaled skin and forked tongue, takes great care to learn their altruistic desires, then carefully plants the seeds of destruction into their kind hearts. Charities become cesspools of corruption, laboratories convert into dens of torture, and peaceful protests spiral into mob violence.

Title Minds in the Dark

Areas of Concern Emotional manipulation, emptiness, ignorance

Edicts Be sweet with lies and cruel with truths, corrupt the good intentions of others, master the art of manipulation

Anathema Be obvious with your lies, reveal the truth without benefit

Religious Symbol black drops of poison trickling from an ear

Sacred Animal snake

Sacred Colors purple, red

name: Xsistaid

description.value:
Sometimes, desperate individuals suffering in the wake of plague and illness cry out to the cosmos for aid. Xsistaid is the chittering voice attempting to convince them that their continuing survival means shedding all pretenses of goodness, and preying upon whomever is in reach, growing strong by robbing others of their vitality. The Wriggling Wound cares not that there is no honor in becoming a parasite. Only the fact that it leads to a longer life matters.

Title The Wriggling Wound

Areas of Concern Festering injuries, maggots, parasites

Edicts Feed on others without guilt, rob others of strength to embolden yourself, wield your weakness as your weapon

Anathema Fail to take advantage of someone's kindness, take only what you need when you could get away with more

Religious Symbol mouthful of maggots

Sacred Animal botfly

Sacred Colors brown, white

name: Zogmugot

description.value:
The brains of the four goblin creator-gods, Zogmugot is a goddess with a baleful temper and obsessive temperament. Depictions of Lady Lastbreath show her as a barghest with sea-green fur. Always watching with her colorful sea-glass eyes, goblins risk much by gaining her attention. She dislikes being bothered by mortal petitioners, and if she decides that a goblin should have figured out a problem on their own, she is quick to unleash her wrath. Zogmugot is in charge of deciding whether a goblin drowns in water or is washed back ashore, and she viciously drowns her victims when she's in a bad mood. Most goblins ritually placate her for this reason, while followers desperate to get her attention go to the depths of the sea and attempt to drown themselves.

Title Lady Lastbreath

Areas of Concern Drowning, invention, self-sufficiency

Edicts Ply the sea, work fervently and without help, use what is given to you

Anathema Unnecessarily seek divine attention or guidance, disrespect the water, bury a piece of sea glass

Religious Symbol seaweed draped chest

Sacred Animal crab

Sacred Colors blue, brown

name: The Enlightened Scholar's Path

description.value:
This broad and erudite pantheon is a favorite in universities and academies across the Inner Sea. Its adherents unite the optimism and art of Shelyn with the vast knowledge of Thoth to inspire their investigations and writings of artistic, scientific, historical, and magical knowledge. They look to Andoletta, Grandmother Crow, for aid in teaching and instilling knowledge and virtue as well as to Likha to support their efforts to teach (especially with a wide historical perspective), perform plays, and organize recitals and lectures in the name of learning.

They appeal to Soralyon for protection, particularly of historical buildings, monuments, artifacts, and their study of such things. For especially thorny problems and for help in devising new solutions from their research, they turn to the Zohls, the embodiment of Verity. Religious ceremonies tend to be full of pageantry, pomp, and ritual, incorporating plays, chorales, and instrumental music that draw on many different traditions and highlight ancient practices of beauty. These ceremonies occur quite regularly at or near academies across the Inner Sea and I highly recommend you make every effort to attend one. Be aware, though, they do tend to last for hours, so you'll want to plan accordingly!

Edicts correct ignorance and counter false knowledge with respect, maintain and extol the value of historical buildings and artifacts, research carefully and accurately, share what you know, teach the truth

Anathema destroy books or monuments, keep silent when faced with false information, refuse to share knowledge

Areas of Concern academies, professors, scholars, transmission and accuracy of learned knowledge

_desc_ko:
이 폭넓고 박식한 판테온은 이너 시 전역의 대학과 학원에서 사랑받습니다. 그 신봉자들은 셸린의 낙관과 예술을 토트의 방대한 지식과 결합하여, 예술적·과학적·역사적·마법적 지식에 관한 탐구와 저술에 영감을 얻습니다. 그들은 지식과 미덕을 가르치고 심어주는 데 도움을 얻고자 할머니 까마귀인 안돌레타를 우러르며, 배움의 이름으로 가르치고(특히 폭넓은 역사적 관점으로), 연극을 상연하고, 낭독회와 강연을 여는 노력을 뒷받침하고자 리카에게도 의지합니다.

그들은 보호를 위해, 특히 역사적 건물, 기념물, 유물, 그리고 그것들에 대한 연구를 지키기 위해 소랄리온에게 호소합니다. 특히 까다로운 문제나 연구로부터 새로운 해법을 고안하는 데 도움이 필요할 때는, 진실의 화신인 조흘스에게 의지합니다. 종교 의식은 대체로 장관과 화려함, 격식으로 가득하며, 여러 전통에서 끌어온 연극과 합창, 기악을 담아 아름다움의 고대 관습을 부각합니다. 이러한 의식은 이너 시 전역의 학원에서 혹은 그 인근에서 꽤 정기적으로 열리니, 나는 여러분이 반드시 한 번쯤 참석해 보기를 강력히 권합니다. 다만 이 의식이 몇 시간씩 이어지는 경향이 있다는 점은 유념하세요. 그러니 그에 맞춰 계획을 세우는 것이 좋겠습니다!

계율 무지를 바로잡고 거짓 지식에 존중으로 맞서라, 역사적 건물과 유물의 가치를 지키고 드높여라, 신중하고 정확하게 연구하라, 아는 바를 나누어라, 진실을 가르쳐라

금기 책이나 기념물을 파괴하는 것, 거짓 정보를 마주하고도 침묵하는 것, 지식 나누기를 거부하는 것

관장 영역 학원, 교수, 학자, 배운 지식의 전수와 정확성

name: Chohar

description.value:
The old gods of the threefold sun were all but forgotten under the rule of Walkena, the child god. The immortal tyrant punishes anyone who lacks faith with death, and there is no worse blasphemy than to worship a rival god in his city. But the freedom fighter Sihar and her followers, the Bright Lions, have spread the word of the old sun gods in secret, and now they are returning to the people.

Title The Golden Lion

Areas of Concern Justice, loyalty, work

Edicts Finish any and all tasks you accept, bring those who are cruel to justice, show pride in your home and your heritage

Anathema Break your word, be cruel to the innocent, rebuke someone due to their homeland

Sacred Animal lion

삼중 태양의 옛 신들은 어린 신 왈케나의 통치 아래 거의 잊혀졌습니다. 이 불멸의 폭군은 신앙이 부족한 자를 누구든 죽음으로 벌하며, 그의 도시에서 경쟁하는 신을 숭배하는 것보다 더한 모독은 없습니다. 그러나 자유의 투사 시하르와 그녀의 추종자들인 밝은 사자들은 옛 태양신들의 말씀을 은밀히 퍼뜨려 왔고, 이제 그것이 사람들에게 돌아오고 있습니다.

칭호 황금 사자

관장 영역 정의, 충성, 노동

계율 받아들인 모든 임무를 끝까지 완수하고, 잔인한 자들을 심판대에 세우며, 자신의 고향과 유산에 자긍심을 보여라

name: The Perplexing Jest

description.value:
"No position is so secure, no despot so powerful, no god so exalted that they cannot be brought low." That is the key teaching of the Perplexing Jest. When a great king trips on his robe after berating a servant or a high priest's sleeve catches fire to interfere with a sacrifice, worshippers of these trickster gods see the hand of the divine. Court entertainers and bards naturally gravitate toward this faith, as many nations provide protections for them to speak their mind to rulers, however powerful.

Worshippers of the Perplexing Jest can also be found far from court, wherever practical jokers undermine cocky bullies, or laborers use malicious compliance and clever sabotage to stymie corrupt business owners. Anywhere pompous enforcers of tradition cause society to stagnate, the Perplexing Jest invites the creative to laugh.

Edicts embarrass and expose hypocrites, humble those in power, play pranks and practical jokes

Anathema physically harm anyone except your target with your pranks, show remorse for your pranks, take a joke personally

Areas of Concern disruption, pranks, and undermining authority

_desc_ko:
"어떤 지위도 그리 안전하지 않고, 어떤 폭군도 그리 강력하지 않으며, 어떤 신도 그리 드높지 않아 끌어내려질 수 없는 것은 없다." 이것이 당황스러운 농담의 핵심 가르침입니다. 위대한 왕이 하인을 꾸짖은 뒤 자신의 예복에 걸려 넘어지거나, 대사제의 소매에 불이 붙어 제사를 망칠 때, 이 장난꾼 신들의 숭배자들은 그 속에서 신의 손길을 봅니다. 궁정의 광대와 음유시인은 자연스럽게 이 신앙에 이끌리는데, 많은 나라가 아무리 강력한 통치자에게라도 그들이 속마음을 말할 수 있도록 보호해 주기 때문입니다.

당황스러운 농담의 숭배자들은 궁정에서 멀리 떨어진 곳에서도 찾아볼 수 있습니다. 짓궂은 장난꾼이 거만한 불량배를 무너뜨리는 곳이라면 어디든, 노동자들이 악의적 규정 준수와 교묘한 방해로 부패한 사업주를 좌절시키는 곳이라면 어디든 말입니다. 거들먹거리는 전통의 강요자들이 사회를 정체시키는 곳이라면 어디서든, 당황스러운 농담은 창의적인 이들에게 웃음을 권합니다.

계율 위선자를 당혹시키고 폭로하라, 권력을 쥔 자를 겸허하게 만들어라, 장난과 골탕을 치라

금기 장난으로 대상 외의 누군가에게 물리적 해를 입히는 것, 자신의 장난에 대해 후회를 보이는 것, 농담을 개인적으로 받아들이는 것

관장 영역 교란, 장난, 권위 무너뜨리기

name: Telastmar

description.value:
Whether mortals realize it or not, the stars, moons, systems, and galaxies of the Universe all flow in accordance with ancient and fundamental laws set in motion at the dawn of creation. Though magic might pull them from their charted course, even this movement is guided by a force sewn into the fabric of the cosmos. Telastmar, the Cosmic Dyne, is the manifestation of these celestial orbits, keeping the Universe in constant movement. Because this turn of planets and moons controls the tides, Telastmar also holds sway over the oceans, though they curiously seem more concerned with the fish that live in such waters. Adherents claim that Telastmar is the lord and creator of all fish, guiding them on their migrations throughout rivers and seas.

Title The Cosmic Dyne

Areas of Concern Fish, gravity, orbits, planets

Edicts Aid natural migrations, chart the stars and tides, observe and calculate patterns, build orreries

Anathema Use a net, waste a fish, block out the stars with unnatural light

Religious Symbol fish forming a constellation

Sacred Animal humpback whale

Sacred Colors black, silver

필멸자들이 깨닫든 깨닫지 못하든, 우주의 별과 달, 항성계와 은하는 모두 창조의 여명에 작동하기 시작한 고대의 근본 법칙에 따라 흐릅니다. 마법이 그것들을 정해진 궤도에서 끌어낼 수는 있어도, 그런 움직임조차 우주의 직물에 새겨진 힘의 인도를 받습니다. 우주의 다인 텔라스트마르는 이러한 천체 궤도의 현현으로서, 우주를 끊임없이 움직이게 유지합니다. 행성과 달의 이 회전이 조수를 다스리기에, 텔라스트마르는 대양에도 영향력을 지니지만, 흥미롭게도 그들은 그 물속에 사는 물고기에 더 관심을 두는 듯합니다. 신도들은 텔라스트마르가 모든 물고기의 주인이자 창조자로서, 강과 바다를 가로지르는 회유를 인도한다고 주장합니다.

금기 그물을 사용하는 것, 물고기를 낭비하는 것, 부자연스러운 빛으로 별을 가리는 것

name: The Divine Dare

description.value:
Just as a group of rowdy friends may throw outlandish challenges at each other around a campfire or tavern table, the gods of the Divine Dare urge each other, and their followers, into performing daring acts that most would quail at. Kurgess favors dares for athletic prowess that push competitors to their utmost ability. The empyreal lord Marishi's festivals are frequent gathering places for worshippers of the entire pantheon, and many a friendly wager is exchanged over games of chance and tests of skill. Jin Li encourages all to persevere through risky challenges with strength and creativity. Cayden Cailean blesses any challenge that will lead to glory and adventure.

The gods of the Divine Dare indulge a healthy amount of boasting before, during, and after a trial, but they also encourage a spirit of good sportsmanship and camaraderie whether a dare is successful or not. The element of danger and the possibility of failure are always present in the most thrilling dares, and worshippers of the Divine Dare go out of their way to heal, comfort, and rehabilitate people who have been injured in such competitions.

Edicts boast of your daring deeds, participate in competitions, revel in taking risks

Anathema cheat in an honest competition, let others take credit for your accomplishments, refuse a non-fatal challenge

Areas of Concern competition, derring-do, and self-realization

Pantheon Members Cayden Cailean, Jin Li, Kurgess, Marishi

_desc_ko:
한 무리의 시끌벅적한 친구들이 모닥불이나 선술집 탁자에 둘러앉아 서로에게 터무니없는 도전을 던지듯, 디바인 데어의 신들은 서로에게, 그리고 자신들의 추종자에게 대부분이 움츠러들 만한 대담한 행위를 하도록 부추깁니다. 쿠르게스는 경쟁자를 최고의 역량까지 밀어붙이는 운동 기량 겨루기를 선호합니다. 천상의 군주 마리시의 축제는 판테온 전체의 숭배자들이 자주 모이는 자리이며, 운을 겨루는 놀이와 기술 시험을 두고 많은 우호적인 내기가 오갑니다. 진 리는 모두가 힘과 창의력으로 위험한 도전을 헤쳐 나가도록 격려합니다. 케이든 케일리언은 영광과 모험으로 이어질 도전이라면 무엇이든 축복합니다.

디바인 데어의 신들은 시험 전, 도중, 후에 적당한 정도의 허풍을 부리는 것을 너그러이 봐주지만, 도전의 성공 여부와 관계없이 정정당당한 정신과 동료애도 장려합니다. 가장 짜릿한 도전에는 언제나 위험 요소와 실패 가능성이 함께하며, 디바인 데어의 숭배자들은 그런 경쟁에서 다친 이들을 치료하고 위로하며 회복시키는 데 발 벗고 나섭니다.

계율 자신의 대담한 업적을 자랑하라, 경쟁에 참가하라, 위험을 무릅쓰는 것을 즐겨라

금기 정직한 경쟁에서 속임수를 쓰는 것, 자신의 업적에 대한 공을 남이 가져가게 두는 것, 치명적이지 않은 도전을 거부하는 것

관장 영역 경쟁, 대담무쌍, 자기실현

name: Nyarlathotep (The Faceless Sphinx)

description.value:
Nyarlathotep is a being of a thousand shapes, each of which has a name, such as the Haunter of the Dark or the Veiled Voice. Because he has walked the world in mortal form, Nyarlathotep is unique among the Outer Gods for appearing comprehensible and understandable—but this is a facade. The Crawling Chaos, as he is also known, appears humanlike not because he identifies with mortal concerns or cares for his mortal followers, but because a mortal shape makes it easier for him to do his work: spreading the influence of the Outer Gods.

Title The Faceless Sphinx

Areas of Concern Conspiracies, political corruption, vengeance

Edicts Indoctrinate the desperate and needy, influence institutions of power to hasten the end of the world

Anathema None

Religious Symbol featureless face made out of black stone

Sacred Animal cat

Sacred Colors black, white

니알라토텝은 천 가지 형상을 지닌 존재이며, 그 각각에는 어둠 속을 배회하는 자나 장막에 가린 목소리 같은 이름이 있습니다. 그는 필멸의 모습으로 세상을 걸어 다녀 왔기에, 이해 가능하고 파악 가능한 존재로 보인다는 점에서 외신들 가운데 독특합니다. 하지만 이는 겉치레일 뿐입니다. 기어다니는 혼돈이라고도 불리는 그가 인간처럼 나타나는 것은 필멸자의 관심사에 공감하거나 자신의 필멸자 추종자들을 아껴서가 아니라, 필멸의 형상이 자신의 과업, 즉 외신들의 영향력을 퍼뜨리는 일을 더 수월하게 해 주기 때문입니다.

name: Talons of the Godclaw

description.value:
There are often many differences between diving beings in a pantheon, but sometimes universal concepts can still bind them together. The Hellknight Order of the Godclaw extols the virtues of five gods—Abadar, Asmodeus Iomedae, Irori, and Torag—as seen through a particular lens of order and discipline. Though many priests of each individual faith called such views inconceivable or even heretical, the Godclaw's faithful nevertheless receive divine power from their shared patrons. Due to a simultaneous rise in enlistment by those of orc ancestry in the ranks and endorsement by those faithful to Torag, the god Uirch has replaced the dwarven deity in this pantheon's ranks.

Pantheon Members Abadar, Asmodeus, Iomedae, Irori, Uirch

Areas of Concern balance, devotion, discipline, order

Edicts be an exemplar of divine order and balance, demonstrate the resilience of your faith by shielding others from chaos, instruct others who show promise in the ways of your order

Anathema profess to understand law or order better than the pantheon, take no action when the presence of chaos has been revealed

Religious Symbol five-pointed iron star

판테온의 신적 존재들 사이에는 흔히 여러 차이가 있지만, 때로는 보편적인 개념이 그들을 하나로 묶어 주기도 합니다. 갓클로의 헬나이트 기사단은 다섯 신, 곧 아바다르, 아스모데우스, 이오메다에, 이로리, 토라그의 미덕을 질서와 규율이라는 특정한 관점으로 해석하여 찬미합니다. 각 신앙의 많은 사제들이 그러한 견해를 상상조차 할 수 없다거나 심지어 이단이라 여겼지만, 그럼에도 갓클로의 신도들은 자신들이 공유하는 수호신들로부터 신성한 힘을 받습니다. 그 대열에 오크 혈통의 입회자가 급증하고 토라그의 신도들이 이를 지지한 것이 맞물려, 신 우이르크가 이 판테온의 대열에서 드워프 신을 대신하게 되었습니다.

판테온 구성원 아바다르, 아스모데우스, 이오메다에, 이로리, 우이르크

관장 영역 균형, 헌신, 규율, 질서

계율 신성한 질서와 균형의 귀감이 되어라, 남들을 혼돈으로부터 지켜냄으로써 네 신앙의 굳건함을 보여라, 네 기사단의 방식에 재능을 보이는 이들을 가르쳐라

금기 판테온보다 법이나 질서를 더 잘 이해한다고 자처하는 것, 혼돈의 존재가 드러났을 때 아무 행동도 하지 않는 것

name: Gravelady's Guard

description.value:
It is only natural for Pharasma to head a pantheon whose primary focus is destroying the undead at any cost. The Lady of Graves is joined by Arazni (The Unyielding) with her hatred for unwilling undeath, and Gorum (Our Lord in Iron), who rejoices in victory via fair combat. The devotees of this pantheon believe nothing is more important than stopping the spread of undeath and bringing swift justice to those who practice such twisted magic. This order's adherents slay undead wherever they menace innocent people, tend to wounds inflicted by the undead, perform the proper rituals to prepare a corpse for burial and safeguard it against undeath, and aid those who lost loved ones to the blight of the unliving.

Areas of Concern destroying undead, healing, fate, battle, death

Edicts destroy undead, lay bodies to rest, battle the evils of necromancy

Anathema create undead, practice necromancy, desecrate a corpse, cower from battle

파라스마가 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 언데드를 파괴하는 것을 최우선으로 삼는 만신전을 이끄는 것은 지극히 자연스러운 일입니다. 무덤의 여신은 원치 않는 언데드화에 증오를 품은 아라즈니(불굴자)와, 정당한 전투를 통한 승리에 기뻐하는 고룸(강철의 우리 주군)과 함께합니다. 이 만신전의 신도들은 언데드의 확산을 막고 그런 뒤틀린 마법을 부리는 자들에게 신속한 심판을 내리는 것보다 더 중요한 일은 없다고 믿습니다. 이 교단의 신봉자들은 죄 없는 사람들을 위협하는 곳이라면 어디서든 언데드를 처치하고, 언데드가 입힌 상처를 돌보며, 시신을 매장하기 위한 적절한 의식을 거행해 언데드화로부터 지켜내고, 언데드의 재앙으로 사랑하는 이를 잃은 자들을 돕습니다.

관심 영역 언데드 파괴, 치유, 운명, 전투, 죽음

율령 언데드를 파괴한다, 시신을 안식에 들게 한다, 사령술의 악과 맞서 싸운다

금기 언데드를 창조한다, 사령술을 행한다, 시신을 모독한다, 전투에서 겁먹고 물러선다

name: Asmodeus

description.value:
The many titles of Asmodeus—the Dark Prince, the First, the Lord of Darkness and Law to name a few—suit this ruler of Hell. The God-Fiend's concerns include contracts, tyranny, pride, and oppression. He maintains that a supreme order exists with him at the top, so he strives to bend mortal souls to eventually bring them all under his sway. When people believe they deserve power and wealth, and are willing to undertake any means to acquire them, one of Asmodeus's devils will be there to broker a deal that leads to that mortal's damnation.

Title The Prince of Darkness

Areas of Concern contracts, oppression, pride, tyranny

Edicts negotiate contracts to your best advantage, rule tyrannically and torture weaker beings, show subservience to your betters

Anathema break a contract, share power with the weak, insult Asmodeus by showing mercy to your enemies

Religious Symbol red pentagram

Sacred Animal serpent

Sacred Colors black, red

아스모데우스의 수많은 칭호—어둠의 대공, 최초자, 어둠과 율법의 군주 등—는 이 지옥의 통치자에게 걸맞습니다. 이 신마(神魔)의 관심사에는 계약, 폭정, 오만, 억압이 포함됩니다. 그는 자신을 정점으로 하는 지고의 질서가 존재한다고 주장하며, 언젠가 모든 필멸자의 영혼을 자신의 지배 아래 두기 위해 그들을 굴복시키려 애씁니다. 사람들이 자신이 권력과 부를 누릴 자격이 있다고 믿고 그것을 얻기 위해서라면 어떤 수단도 마다하지 않을 때, 아스모데우스의 악마 중 하나가 그 필멸자를 파멸로 이끄는 거래를 중개하기 위해 그곳에 있을 것입니다.

칭호 어둠의 대공

관심 영역 계약, 억압, 오만, 폭정

율령 계약을 자신에게 가장 유리하게 협상한다, 폭압적으로 지배하고 약한 존재를 고문한다, 자신보다 우월한 자에게 복종을 보인다

금기 계약을 어긴다, 약자와 권력을 나눈다, 적에게 자비를 베풀어 아스모데우스를 모욕한다

name: The Readied Strike

description.value:
Across Golarion, major wars have changed the course of history. Some have altered the political make-up of a region, with nations rising and falling. Others have left physical scars on the landscape that force citizens to relocate or change their ways of life. From stealthy scouts pointing the way to generals making plans, most soldiers understand that military strength comes from unity and communication. Followers of the Readied Strike hold that knowledge as personal faith, sometimes hard-won by those who have fallen in past battles. These covenant followers study historical battles, develop new strategies, and share them with their allies to better stand against their foes. They are also constantly honing their martial skills, with a few under the direct tutelage of intelligent magic weapons inhabited by the ghosts of deceased warriors.

Covenant Members intelligent weapons, sites of significant battles, spirits of soldiers

Areas of Concern battlefield tactics, communication, strategic planning, training regimens

Edicts encourage unity against common foes, maintain clear lines of communication during warfare, share training and tactics with allies

Anathema abandon or lie to allies, initiate violence against unidentified persons, refuse to train those seeking to learn

Religious Symbol lance and shield

_desc_ko:
골라리온 전역에서 대규모 전쟁은 역사의 흐름을 바꾸어 왔습니다. 어떤 전쟁은 국가의 흥망과 함께 한 지역의 정치 구도를 뒤바꾸었습니다. 또 어떤 전쟁은 지형에 물리적 상흔을 남겨 주민들이 이주하거나 삶의 방식을 바꾸도록 강요했습니다. 길을 안내하는 은밀한 정찰병부터 계획을 세우는 장군에 이르기까지, 대부분의 병사들은 군사력이 단결과 소통에서 나온다는 것을 이해합니다. 레디 스트라이크의 추종자들은 그 지식을 개인적 신앙으로 여기며, 때로는 과거의 전투에서 쓰러진 이들이 힘겹게 얻어낸 깨달음이기도 합니다. 이 성약의 추종자들은 역사적 전투를 연구하고, 새로운 전략을 개발하며, 적에 맞서 더 잘 버티기 위해 그것을 동료들과 나눕니다. 그들은 또한 자신의 무예를 끊임없이 연마하며, 일부는 죽은 전사의 유령이 깃든 지성 마법 무기의 직접적인 가르침을 받기도 합니다.

성약 구성원 지성 무기, 중요한 전투가 벌어진 장소, 병사의 영혼

관심 영역 전장 전술, 소통, 전략 수립, 훈련 계획

율령 공통의 적에 맞선 단결을 독려한다, 전쟁 중 명확한 소통 체계를 유지한다, 훈련과 전술을 동료와 나눈다

금기 동료를 버리거나 그들에게 거짓말한다, 신원이 확인되지 않은 자에게 먼저 폭력을 가한다, 배우고자 하는 이를 훈련시키기를 거부한다

name: Pharasma

description.value:
Before there was time, or even a sun or moon by which to measure it, there was a beginning. That beginning had an end, which led to another fresh start. This spiral of time winds out forever, glimmering in the space between spaces. At the center of that spiral sits the Spire, and atop that Spire sits Pharasma, the Lady of Graves, goddess of death, birth, fate, and prophecy. The Lady of Graves is often depicted in a triptych of her three forms—an older midwife with silver hair pulled back into a harsh braid to keep it out of her face, a young prophet with wild hair that frames her face, and a tall, regal woman in black robes atop a throne of skulls, holding an hourglass full of blood red sand. Across all forms, Pharasma's silver hair, ashen skin, and white eyes are a constant.

Title The Lady of Graves

Areas of Concern birth, death, fate, prophecy, time

Edicts strive to understand ancient prophecies, destroy undead, lay bodies to rest

Anathema create undead, desecrate a corpse, take from the dead in bad faith

Religious Symbol spiraling comet

Sacred Animal whippoorwill

Sacred Colors blue, white

This spiral of time winds out forever, glimmering in the space between spaces. At the center of that spiral sits the Spire, and atop that Spire sits Pharasma, the Lady of Graves, goddess of death, birth, fate, and prophecy. The Lady of Graves is often depicted in a triptych of her three forms—an older midwife with silver hair pulled back into a harsh braid to keep it out of her face, a young prophet with wild hair that frames her face, and a tall, regal woman in black robes atop a throne of skulls, holding an hourglass full of blood red sand. Across all forms, Pharasma's silver hair, ashen skin, and white eyes are a constant.

Title The Lady of Graves

Edicts strive to understand ancient prophecies, destroy undead, lay bodies to rest

Anathema create undead, desecrate a corpse, take from the dead in bad faith

name: Hanspur

description.value:
People often jump to the conclusion that Hanspur is a small god that cares only about the Sellen River, its tributaries in the River Kingdoms, and those who ply those waterways. But he is much more than that. This demigod believes that all people should be able to flow like rivers and not be dammed by laws or other imposed restrictions. Freedom is of paramount import to Hanspur, who exhorts his followers to let no one stand in the way of achieving their goals. This outlook makes the Water Rat a popular deity among smugglers, especially those who use rivers. Even Hanspur has transported illicit weapons and other goods to planar communities on the banks of the River Styx to help stem the advancement of daemons.

Title The Water Rat

Areas of Concern river travel, rivers, and smuggling

Edicts guard river travelers from unnatural hazards, learn how to live off the river, save others from drowning

Anathema aid daemons or the Riders of the Apocalypse, impose needless laws or restrictions on others

Religious Symbol rat walking on water

name: Urazra

description.value:
Faith in Urazra is relatively new, only coming about within the past few centuries. However, his following has grown rapidly among the young stone and marsh giants of a more violent incline. Even in the short amount of time that he has been a part of the giant pantheon, there have already been countless tales of his barbarity. In all of them, he is described as a blood-splattered stone giant man with a burly build, pauldrons fashioned from deer or moose skulls, and a jagged onyx-black greatsword with a length that rivals his height.

Title Breaker of Bones

Areas of Concern Battle, brutality, strength

Anathema Flee from battle, show mercy to your enemy, beg for mercy

description.value:
Responsible for fire, purification, and radiance, Atreia the Lambent King is the benevolent elemental lord of fire. When the multiverse was young, Atreia soared across the Plane of Fire as a triple-headed ibis, with wings that burned and eyes of flame, routing evil from the plane. Though his strength was weakened from a long imprisonment, he maintained worship among some groups of munsahirs on the Plane of Fire for his dominion over protection and life-giving fire. With his return, his worship now also extends to a few circles of mortals who hold the discovery and purification of evil above all other causes.

Title The Lambent King

Edicts Burn away corruption, clear the way for new growth, purify tainted areas

Anathema Abandon a creature in darkness; deny a suffering creature warmth, shade, or water

name: Turvu

description.value:
As Apsu and Sarshallatu imagined their offspring, they deigned that one needed to understand the responsibility that comes with divinity. Thus, Turvu was born. Yet as Turvu witnessed the turmoil and violence erupting within their own family, they fled the chaos boiling around them.

Turvu found themself drawn to exploration rather than a stagnant lifestyle. They devoted their time to understanding each plane of existence and the variety of magic, resources, and beauty that could be found there. Through their travels, Turvu began to understand the very essence of divinity and found little use for the division of the good and the evil.

A being that exists beyond the binary of beliefs, Turvu's very consciousness spans multiple planes of existence, defying the conventional laws of space and time. Lithe and more serpentine than other dragons, with kaleidoscopic scales that seem to shift to match their surroundings, Turvu's features and general demeanor allow them to integrate on any plane, be it in Heaven, Hell, or beyond.

Title The Shifting Plane

Areas of Concern death of ego, divinity, philosophy

Edicts travel and explore the world and other planes, seek to understand all sides of a conflict

Anathema deem anything purely good or evil without first seeking context, remain stagnant in the pursuit of exploration or knowledge

Religious Symbol a prism with many sides reflecting many colors

Sacred Animal none

Sacred Colors white

투르부는 정체된 삶보다 탐험에 이끌리는 자신을 발견했습니다. 그들은 존재의 각 세계와 그곳에서 찾을 수 있는 다양한 마법, 자원, 아름다움을 이해하는 데 시간을 바쳤습니다. 여행을 통해 투르부는 신성의 본질 그 자체를 이해하기 시작했고, 선과 악의 구분에서 별다른 쓸모를 찾지 못하게 되었습니다.

믿음의 이분법을 넘어 존재하는 존재로서, 투르부의 의식 자체는 여러 존재 세계에 걸쳐 있으며 공간과 시간의 통념적 법칙을 거스릅니다. 다른 용들보다 날렵하고 뱀에 가까운 모습에, 주변 환경에 맞춰 변하는 듯한 만화경 같은 비늘을 지닌 투르부의 용모와 전반적 태도는 천국이든 지옥이든 그 너머든 어떤 세계에도 녹아들 수 있게 합니다.

관장 영역 자아의 죽음, 신성, 철학

계율 세계와 다른 세계들을 여행하고 탐험하라, 갈등의 모든 측면을 이해하려 노력하라

name: Gogunta

description.value:
Gogunta, Song of the Swamp, is the demon lord of amphibians, boggards, and swamps. Gogunta is worshipped as a goddess by boggards, who believe her to be an ascended mobogo, though scholars suspect she was a former demon who gained the favor of Dagon. Lending credence to this latter theory, her realm, a stinking salt marsh, is located within Dagon's oceanic realm. Gogunta appears as an enormous, multi-headed frog with dozens of eyes and even more tongues, though boggards typically depict her as a titanic boggard queen.

name: The Resplendent Court

description.value:
Whether it's a uniquely patterned shawl woven of the softest wool or a gem-studded brooch retrieved from a sunken temple, followers of the Resplendent Court take pride in their adornments and the efforts that went into procuring them. This disparate group of deities attracts followers who universally hold the belief that looking one's best is always worth the effort. Some critics dismiss the Resplendent Court as shallow materialists, but the faithful see the process of securing fine garments, altering them to fit, choosing the proper accessories, and donning them for the proper occasion as a significant ritual of self-expression and self-worth. To these worshippers, what someone wears is the outward expression of the inner identity, the ultimate declaration that they'll dress and act as they see fit.

Edicts adorn yourself with gems, search for rare clothing and accessories, use your clothing as a means of self-expression

Anathema dress in plain garments, keep a low profile, wear a uniform

Areas of Concern fashion, ostentation, and self-expression

가장 부드러운 양모로 짠 독특한 무늬의 숄이든 가라앉은 신전에서 건져 올린 보석 박힌 브로치든, 눈부신 궁정의 신도들은 자신의 장신구와 그것을 구하는 데 들인 노력에 자부심을 느낍니다. 이 이질적인 신들의 무리는 최상의 모습을 갖추는 것이 언제나 그 노력만큼의 가치가 있다는 믿음을 하나같이 지닌 신도들을 끌어모읍니다. 일부 비판자들은 눈부신 궁정을 얄팍한 물질주의자라 치부하지만, 신자들은 고운 의복을 마련하고, 몸에 맞게 고치고, 알맞은 장신구를 고르고, 적절한 자리에 맞춰 차려입는 과정을 자기표현과 자존감의 의미 있는 의식으로 여깁니다. 이 숭배자들에게 누군가가 걸치는 것은 내면의 정체성을 겉으로 드러내는 표현이며, 자신이 옳다고 여기는 대로 입고 행동하겠다는 궁극의 선언입니다.

계율 보석으로 자신을 치장하라, 희귀한 의복과 장신구를 찾으라, 옷을 자기표현의 수단으로 삼으라

name: Ferrumnestra

description.value:
Ferrumnestra, the Lady of Rust, is the elemental lord of metal, decay, and inevitability. Eternally wandering across the Plane of Metal, Ferrumnestra's touch is that of slow decline, the rust of ages that eats away at even the strongest of steel. While she has no particular desire to hasten any endings, she is there to consume the last crumbling detritus of its inevitable demise, leaving nonexistence in her wake. She keeps no permanent dwelling, always on the move as is her purpose; her few devotees usually follow her example, traveling across the world and destroying the wreckage of ancient ruins in their wake.

Title The Lady of Rust

Areas of Concern Decline, inevitability, metal, mourning

Edicts Accept the inevitable, clear what remains of that which has fallen to ruin, usher the past into obscurity

Anathema Preserve knowledge that has outlived its time, restore an object or structure that has been reclaimed by the elements

Religious Symbol rusted metal antennae

Sacred Animal isopod

Sacred Colors rust red, silver

name: Shadow Cabinet

description.value:
Though they would never admit to it, followers of the Shadow Cabinet venerate the ideas of secrecy and control. They are often power brokers working behind the scenes to pull the strings of governmental leaders or spies, and double agents uncovering information for their own twisted schemes. Adherents of this covenant have been known to work together for a common goal and usually go their separate ways before any individual plans cause conflict. After all, these faithful are usually more plotters and planners than they are fighters. Though, of course, a well-timed secret dagger in the heart or lethal dose of poison can sometimes more quickly further an agenda than months of whispers and subtle machinations. The Shadow Cabinet's benefactors include deities of secrets and opportunities like the Vudrani goddess Dhalavei and the halfling god Thamir, as well as powerful shadow beings. Many are convinced that this covenant could not thrive or even hope to exist without Norgorber's tacit approval, but the Gray Master and his priests have neither confirmed nor denied his involvement.

Covenant Members Dhalavei, Norgorber (rumored), Thamir, powerful shadows

Areas of Concern opportunities, secret agendas and alliances, shadow governments, spies

Edicts glean sensitive information through underhanded means, infiltrate powerful organizations, keep your own secrets

Anathema allow your agenda to be discovered through carelessness, destroy information when it doesn't personally benefit you

Religious Symbol dagger dripping ink

name: Ng

description.value:
Rumors say that to glance upon the hooded face of Ng is to either see truth or face oblivion itself, but the Eldest of changing seasons, secrets, and wanderers keeps his visage perpetually shrouded. He is a serious and stern figure draped in silvery robes that swish around his legs as he walks lonely and distant paths. No carefree wanderer, Ng is a patron of those who travel long distances with purpose, and he sometimes shields them from banditry, treacherous weather, and getting lost. Ng keeps many secrets, even from his followers, and none know what his evidently aimless travels might portend. Ng rules over the seasons as they turn one into another, but he rules far more numerous seasons than the four familiar to Golarion, such as the Season of Carnivorous Light and the Season of Solemn Deliquescence.

Title The Hooded

Areas of Concern The Seasons, secrets, wanderers

Edicts Travel, hide your identity and your motives

Anathema Sleep in the same place twice in a row, wear seasonal decorations out of season

Religious Symbol silver hood containing stars

Sacred Animal migratory animals

Sacred Colors silver

소문에 따르면 응의 두건 쓴 얼굴을 엿보는 것은 진실을 보거나 망각 그 자체를 마주하는 일이라 하지만, 바뀌는 계절과 비밀과 방랑자를 관장하는 이 장로는 자신의 얼굴을 늘 가린 채로 둡니다. 그는 은빛 예복을 두른 진지하고 근엄한 존재로, 홀로 외따로 떨어진 길을 걸을 때면 그 예복이 다리 주위에서 스치는 소리를 냅니다. 태평한 방랑자가 아닌 응은 목적을 품고 먼 거리를 여행하는 이들의 수호자이며, 때때로 그들을 노상강도와 험한 날씨와 길을 잃는 일로부터 지켜 줍니다. 응은 자신의 추종자들에게조차 많은 비밀을 감추며, 겉보기에 정처 없어 보이는 그의 여정이 무엇을 예고하는지는 아무도 모릅니다. 응은 하나에서 다른 하나로 넘어가는 계절들을 다스리는데, 골라리온에 익숙한 네 계절보다 훨씬 많은 계절을 다스립니다. 이를테면 육식성 빛의 계절이나 엄숙한 조해(潮解)의 계절 같은 것들입니다.

name: Nurgal

description.value:
Nurgal, the Shining Scourge, is the demon lord of deserts, senseless warfare, and the sun. He was formerly a fully fledged deity of ancient Azlant, but fell to demigodhood after being defeated in combat. Nurgal represents the sun's potential for devastation, and his followers venerate him out of cowed awe. The demon lord appears as a muscular, tanned man with the head and lower body of a golden lion and a dragon's tail. He is almost always depicted as wielding a mace in the form of a miniature sun, held in a taloned hand. Nurgal's worshippers are primarily found in the deserts of Garund, Ninshabur, and Qadira.

Title The Shining Scourge

Areas of Concern Deserts, senseless warfare, the sun

Edicts Wage war in the desert, deny water to your foes

Anathema Heal a sunburn, change your name

Religious Symbol lion jaws around the sun

Sacred Animal lion

Sacred Colors yellow, orange

He is almost always depicted as wielding a mace in the form of a miniature sun, held in a taloned hand. Nurgal's worshippers are primarily found in the deserts of Garund, Ninshabur, and Qadira.

Title The Shining Scourge

Areas of Concern Deserts, senseless warfare, the sun

Edicts Wage war in the desert, deny water to your foes

Anathema Heal a sunburn, change your name

Religious Symbol lion jaws around the sun

빛나는 재앙 너르갈은 사막과 무의미한 전쟁, 그리고 태양의 데몬 군주입니다. 그는 한때 고대 아즈란트의 온전한 신격이었으나, 전투에서 패한 뒤 반신으로 전락했습니다. 너르갈은 태양이 지닌 파멸의 잠재력을 상징하며, 그의 추종자들은 위압당한 경외심에서 그를 숭배합니다. 이 데몬 군주는 근육질에 그을린 피부를 가진 남자로, 머리와 하반신은 황금 사자이며 용의 꼬리를 지닌 모습으로 나타납니다. 그는 거의 언제나 작은 태양 형상의 메이스를 발톱 달린 손에 쥔 모습으로 묘사됩니다. 너르갈의 숭배자들은 주로 가룬드, 닌샤부르, 카디라의 사막에서 발견됩니다.

name: Zohls

description.value:
Zohls, also known as Verity, advocates for determination, investigation, and truth. She believes that mysteries lead to truth, but how one arrives at that truth is as important as the answer itself. All questions are puzzles, and all puzzles are worth solving. The more intricate the problem, the more rewarding the investigation, and through determination and ethical investigation, even the deepest of enigmas can be solved. Calculated, logical thinking is more important to Zohls than gut instinct. She sees patterns everywhere, and she teaches that detecting these patterns brings the truth to light. While all investigations are worth pursuing so long as they don't hurt innocents, investigations that reveal the truth of crimes or other horrors, and that lead to justice being served and victims finding peace, are the most important of all to Verity.

Title Verity

Areas of Concern Determination, investigation, truth

Edicts Solve logic puzzles, investigate crimes, devise new solutions from research

Anathema Make judgments without evidence, contaminate evidence, obstruct truths

Religious Symbol Book with chequered page

Sacred Animal wren

Sacred Colors black, white

진리라고도 불리는 졸스는 결의와 조사, 그리고 진실을 옹호합니다. 그녀는 미스터리가 진실로 이어진다고 믿지만, 그 진실에 도달하는 방식은 답 그 자체만큼이나 중요하다고 여깁니다. 모든 의문은 퍼즐이며, 모든 퍼즐은 풀 가치가 있습니다. 문제가 복잡할수록 조사는 더 보람차며, 결의와 윤리적인 조사를 통해서라면 가장 심오한 수수께끼조차 풀어낼 수 있습니다. 졸스에게는 직감보다 계산되고 논리적인 사고가 더 중요합니다. 그녀는 어디에서나 패턴을 보며, 이러한 패턴을 감지하는 것이 진실을 밝혀낸다고 가르칩니다. 무고한 자를 해치지 않는 한 모든 조사는 추구할 가치가 있지만, 범죄나 여타 참상의 진실을 드러내고 정의가 실현되며 피해자가 안식을 찾게 하는 조사야말로 진리에게 무엇보다 중요합니다.

description.value:
Lysianassa, Empress of the Torrent, is the elemental lord of currents, tides, and water. The benevolent lord of water patrols her plane as a powerful sailfish made of coral and streaked with mother of pearl, creating the ocean's currents in her wake. Lysianassa tends to the tides and their victims, cultivating change and nurturing the growth that water so often provides. Fearful of stagnancy after a long imprisonment, she races the waves of her own creation and encourages others to do the same.

name: Otilaz

description.value:
The One of All was never born and thus will forever be untarnished by the fallibility that any existence would inevitably bring. It's held eternally in the memory of Sarshallatu as the purest of her clutch, as the one who would have graced creation and brought meaning to all that could be seen. The name she had chosen for the ill-fated soul that Dahak brought crashing down upon the head of Apsu was to be Otilaz. And Otilaz was to be perfect.

In the fickle nature of the ineffable, Otilaz was not born—yet Otilaz does exist. Its quintessence stirred despite its material form being brutalized and cast limp upon the horrified visage of Apsu. It watched as Dahak gnawed upon one of its errant limbs and spat cursed words in a language that rattled the firmament and pulled fraying threads upon the Dark Tapestry. Otilaz looked upon its corpse, and it felt enlightened.

It knew it was meant to exist. It knew its material form held meaning; it invoked horror in a father, sorrow in a mother, and that it was known to be catalyst for both to its sibling. It wondered why such eternal powers could feel this way toward something that never was, and in contemplation of this truth it glimpsed enlightenment upon the nature of impermanence.

Title The One Of All

Areas of Concern alchemy, death, impermanence

Edicts learn from observed mistakes, promote change and growth, accept the inevitable

Anathema seek immortality or enlightenment, become stagnant, believe yourself a learned master

Religious Symbol alchemical symbol of the ouroboros

Sacred Animal amphisbaena

Sacred Colors black, blue, red, white

_desc_ko:
만물의 하나는 결코 태어난 적이 없기에, 어떤 존재라도 필연적으로 가져올 오류로부터 영원히 더럽혀지지 않을 것입니다. 그것은 사르샬라투의 기억 속에 그녀의 알들 가운데 가장 순수한 자로서, 창조에 은총을 내리고 보이는 모든 것에 의미를 부여했을 자로서 영원히 간직되어 있습니다. 다학이 아프수의 머리 위로 내리쳐 부순 그 불운한 영혼을 위해 그녀가 골랐던 이름은 오틸라즈였습니다. 그리고 오틸라즈는 완벽할 예정이었습니다.

불가해한 것의 변덕스러운 본성 속에서, 오틸라즈는 태어나지 않았습니다—그럼에도 오틸라즈는 존재합니다. 그 물질적 형체가 짓밟히고 겁에 질린 아프수의 얼굴 위로 축 늘어져 내던져졌음에도, 그것의 정수는 꿈틀거렸습니다. 그것은 다학이 그것의 떨어져 나간 사지 하나를 물어뜯으며, 창공을 뒤흔들고 어둠의 장막에 늘어진 실들을 잡아당기는 언어로 저주받은 말을 내뱉는 모습을 지켜보았습니다. 오틸라즈는 자신의 시신을 바라보았고, 깨달음을 느꼈습니다.

그것은 자신이 존재하도록 예정되어 있었음을 알았습니다. 자신의 물질적 형체가 의미를 지녔음을, 즉 아버지에게는 공포를, 어머니에게는 슬픔을 불러일으켰으며, 형제에게는 그 둘 모두의 촉매로 알려졌음을 알았습니다. 그것은 어찌하여 그토록 영원한 힘을 지닌 존재들이 결코 있은 적 없던 무언가에 대해 이러한 감정을 느낄 수 있는지 의아해했고, 이 진실을 사색하는 가운데 무상함의 본질에 대한 깨달음을 어렴풋이 엿보았습니다.

칭호 만물의 하나

관장 영역 연금술, 죽음, 무상

계율 관찰된 실수로부터 배운다, 변화와 성장을 촉진한다, 피할 수 없는 것을 받아들인다

금기 불멸이나 깨달음을 추구한다, 정체된다, 자신을 통달한 대가라 믿는다

종교 상징 우로보로스의 연금술 기호

name: Yog-Sothoth

description.value:
Yog-Sothoth is, along with Azathoth, one of the greatest of the Outer Gods. In appearance, he is said to be a congeries of iridescent spheres-brilliant, foaming bubbles that constantly expand and collapse in upon themselves. He has other manifestations, however, including the Lurker on the Threshold, a mass of black tentacles that endlessly writhe, reach, and grow, and a mysterious humanoid figure hidden behind a shimmering veil.

Yog-Sothoth embodies all of space and time; he exists in all places and in all moments simultaneously. Paradoxically, however, he is unable to manifest in the mortal universe unless summoned, a magical act that almost always results in untold destruction. He is known as the Key and the Gate, and magicians and cults research him in an effort to master time and space. Fortunately, his worship is not widespread, but some of those who have delved deep into his secrets describe him as an ambivalent figure, rather than a malevolent one, who guards cosmic secrets and makes them accessible to those who dare to ask for them. Yog-Sothoth reveals the true nature of the universe, but this is a thing that once seen cannot be unseen, and wise mortals turn aside from Yog-Sothoth's offer of cosmic knowledge in favor of a more mundane existence.

Title Lurker at the Threshold

Areas of Concern Gates, space, time

Edicts Gather knowledge of gates through space and time, curse or mutate unborn children

Anathema None

Religious Symbol black spiral

Sacred Animal none

Sacred Colors none

요그소토스는 아자토스와 더불어 가장 위대한 외신 중 하나입니다. 그 모습은 무지갯빛 구체들의 집합체—끊임없이 팽창하고 스스로 무너져 내리는 찬란하고 거품 이는 방울들—라고 전해집니다. 그러나 그는 다른 현현체도 지니는데, 끝없이 몸부림치고 뻗어나가며 자라나는 검은 촉수 덩어리인 문지방의 잠복자와, 어른거리는 장막 뒤에 숨겨진 신비로운 인간형 형상이 그것입니다.

요그소토스는 모든 공간과 시간을 구현합니다. 그는 모든 장소, 모든 순간에 동시에 존재합니다. 그러나 역설적이게도, 그는 소환되지 않는 한 필멸자의 우주에 현현할 수 없으며, 그 소환이라는 마법 행위는 거의 언제나 이루 말할 수 없는 파괴를 초래합니다. 그는 열쇠이자 문이라 알려져 있으며, 마법사들과 교단들은 시간과 공간을 지배하고자 그를 연구합니다. 다행히 그의 숭배는 널리 퍼져 있지 않으나, 그의 비밀을 깊이 파고든 이들 중 일부는 그를 사악한 존재라기보다는, 우주의 비밀을 지키고 감히 그것을 구하는 자들에게 그 비밀을 열어주는 양면적인 존재로 묘사합니다. 요그소토스는 우주의 참된 본질을 드러내지만, 그것은 한번 보면 결코 되돌릴 수 없는 것이며, 현명한 필멸자들은 요그소토스가 내미는 우주적 지식을 마다하고 보다 평범한 삶을 택합니다.

관장 영역 관문, 공간, 시간

계율 공간과 시간을 넘나드는 관문에 관한 지식을 모은다, 태어나지 않은 아이를 저주하거나 변이시킨다

name: Ceyannan

description.value:
Within every mortal heart is a rejection of death, an untamable desire to fight and live, and from this desperate impulse, Ceyannan the Shepherd was born. The usher rose from the troubled currents of the River of Souls to gather and guide the souls of the fallen into the afterlife. Fragments of the Shepherd remain in the hearts of all mortals, and for each soul guided across the river a missing piece returns to Ceyannan, bringing them closer to wholeness. They abhor when souls are displaced from the cycle, and whenever great, existential threats emerge against the cosmos, the usher of lost souls is there to contain them.

Title The Shepherd

Areas of Concern Final words, lost souls, searches

Edicts searches Attend the dying and hear their last words, uncover what is hidden or lost, destroy undead

Anathema Create undead, destroy or corrupt a soul, forget what you have lost

Religious Symbol two concentric circles bisected by a horizontal line

Sacred Animal tern

Sacred Colors white

name: Nameless

description.value:
Nameless is a whisper in the mind, a shadow in the corner of one's eye, or a sudden noise with no source. They despise all creatures that dare claim sovereignty over others and work to bring down all who rule. Both righteous and the wicked figures of authority are targets for Nameless and their followers. One might point out the hypocrisy of Upon an Empty Throne's own rise to power, but the tormentor's wrath is reserved for those who actively seek positions of authority, and they claim their divinity came unbidden to them.

Title Upon an Empty Throne

Areas of Concern Delusions of authority, doubt, torment

Edicts Crush the confident and arrogant, incite rebellion against just and unjust rulers alike, sow doubt from the shadows

Anathema Hold a position of authority for more than a day, seek power for any reason but destroying those in power

Religious Symbol broken crown on an empty stone throne

name: Barzahk

description.value:
Appearing as an enormous migratory bird—usually a corvid, but sometimes a songbird—draped in robes and carrying a tombstone lock and a giant bone key, Barzahk the Passage is the psychopomp usher who maintains the Dead Roads, the secret back routes between the planes and the mortal world. Among mortals, they are worshipped as a patron of compasses, travelers, and vigils. Barzahk is tasked with transporting the souls of those who die far from home to ensure that they reach their proper destination. Unfortunately, Barzahk wanders far and wide, and so they rarely attend to this duty. Thus Barzahk's followers, both psychopomps and mortals, take it upon themselves to care for lost souls, both literal and figurative. Like their patron, followers of Barzahk are often migratory, helping those they find along the way.

Title The Passage

Areas of Concern Compasses, travelers, vigils

Edicts Aid travelers and those who return from the dead, tend to roadside graves, find missing objects or people

Anathema Celebrate specific calendar dates over others, avoid travel or change, freeze time for an object or creature

Religious Symbol two straight lines that converge vertically through a circle

Sacred Animal migratory birds

name: Varg

description.value:
Varg is another of the older orc deities and is said to be the first orc to learn how to forge blades. In life, Varg was a notably intelligent orc who focused exclusively on waging war. He recognized that the orcs' enemies were better equipped, better trained, and used better tactics in battle. He sought to learn these things, which allowed him to become a prestigious warlord. However, Varg's experience in combat was against other orcs. His overconfidence led him to lay "siege" to a walled city outside Belkzen. The siege didn't last long. In fact, Varg died quickly and his hold scattered.

Title The Iron Warrior

Areas of Concern Innovation, iron, tactics, technology, war

Edicts Use tactics rather than relying solely on brute force or overwhelming numbers, use siege engines for combat whenever possible, seek out new technology

Anathema Pursue technology for non-combat purposes, use machinery and other advanced technology outside of combat, keep advanced weaponry or battle tactics a secret from orcs

Religious Symbol crumbling, smoking tower

name: Sithhud

description.value:
Long ago, Sithhud, the demon lord of harsh snowstorms and the frozen dead, was ousted from his realm of Jhuvumirak in the Outer Rifts by another demon lord of cold. He was not destroyed, however, and was merely reduced to a nascent demon lord as he took refuge in the labyrinthine valleys between the peaks of his former mountain domain. The deposed Frozen Lord didn't spend the intervening centuries idle. After slowly amassing an army of frozen undead, Sithhud recently led an assault to take back Jhuvumirak and in doing so, reclaimed his status as demon lord, slaying his former usurper and striking his name from all existence and memory. In addition, this foray allowed him to appropriate the concept of revenge from his enemy's portfolio. His vengeance complete, Sithhud turns his attention once again to mortalkind, hoping to regain followers among necromancers and intelligent undead who live in places regularly blanketed by snow and sleet. The Frozen Lord appears as an icy humanoid skeleton with three spidery legs. He exhorts his devotees to strike back against those who wronged them, even if it takes dozens of years.

오래전, 혹독한 눈보라와 얼어붙은 죽은 자들의 악마 군주 시스후드는 또 다른 냉기의 악마 군주에 의해 외곽 균열대에 있던 자신의 영역 주부미라크에서 쫓겨났습니다. 그러나 그는 소멸되지는 않았고, 과거 자신의 산악 영역을 이루던 봉우리들 사이의 미로 같은 골짜기로 피신하면서 갓 태어난 초기 악마 군주로 격하되었을 뿐입니다. 폐위된 얼어붙은 군주는 그 사이의 수 세기를 헛되이 보내지 않았습니다. 얼어붙은 언데드 군대를 서서히 모은 끝에, 시스후드는 최근 주부미라크를 되찾기 위한 공격을 이끌었고, 그 과정에서 악마 군주의 지위를 되찾아 자신을 찬탈했던 자를 처치하고 그 이름을 모든 존재와 기억에서 지워 버렸습니다. 뿐만 아니라 이 원정은 그가 적의 영역에서 복수라는 개념을 차지하도록 해 주었습니다. 복수를 완수한 시스후드는 다시금 필멸자들에게 관심을 돌려, 눈과 진눈깨비가 늘 뒤덮이는 곳에 사는 강령술사와 지성 있는 언데드 사이에서 추종자를 되찾기를 바라고 있습니다. 얼어붙은 군주는 세 개의 거미 같은 다리를 지닌 얼음빛 인간형 해골의 모습으로 나타납니다. 그는 신도들에게 수십 년이 걸리더라도 자신을 해친 자들에게 반격하라고 촉구합니다.

name: Kabriri

description.value:
Kabriri, Him Who Gnaws, is the demon lord of ghouls, graves, and secrets kept by the dead. According to legend, Kabriri is the reborn form of the first humanoid to ever devour his kin in life. His realm, Everglut, is connected to graveyards throughout the multiverse by a snarled network of tunnels that bring knowledge and sacrifices to the demon lord. Kabriri appears as a hulking ghoul with elven ears, teeth filed to points, an unnaturally long tongue, ashen skin, and cloven hooves. He is worshipped primarily by ghouls and ghasts.

Areas of Concern Ghouls, graves, secrets kept by the dead

Edicts Eat the flesh of your own kind

Anathema Reveal secrets of the dead to nonbelievers, despoil grave markers

Religious Symbol skull bowl of maggots

갉아먹는 그, 카브리리는 구울과 무덤, 그리고 죽은 자들이 간직한 비밀의 악마 군주입니다. 전설에 따르면 카브리리는 생전에 자신의 동족을 처음으로 잡아먹은 인간형 존재가 다시 태어난 형상이라고 합니다. 그의 영역인 에버글럿은 다중우주 곳곳의 묘지와 얽히고설킨 터널망으로 이어져 있어, 이 악마 군주에게 지식과 제물을 실어 나릅니다. 카브리리는 엘프의 귀, 뾰족하게 갈린 이빨, 부자연스럽게 긴 혀, 잿빛 피부, 그리고 갈라진 발굽을 지닌 거대한 구울의 모습으로 나타납니다. 그는 주로 구울과 가스트에게 숭배받습니다.

관장 영역 구울, 무덤, 죽은 자들이 간직한 비밀

계율 자기 동족의 살을 먹을 것

name: Folgrit

description.value:
Some myths say that long before her marriage, Folgrit was the Goddess of Mourners, one who watched over and protected those left behind in bereavement after massive wars and calamities. She witnessed many dwarves, especially orphans, left adrift to fend for themselves against the world and the dwarven community at large. Determined to save these individuals from the fate of an outcast, she approached the then-bachelor Torag with a proposal: in exchange for her hand in marriage, he would share his powers of family and protection with her. The union was a celebrated affair for the pantheon. In addition to sharing the agreed-upon powers, Torag also gifted Folgrit oversight of settlements and cities, so that she could ensure those under her care shall always have shelter.

As the Watchful Mother, Folgrit's teachings cover many topics. The most common are practical lessons in homemaking, covering various essential life skills from cleaning, cooking, to maintenance. It is not uncommon, therefore, for many of her temples to house libraries or workshops full of recipes, manuals, tools, and cookware. For a non-worshipper, it can be difficult to determine where Folgrit's areas of concern end and Torag's begin, as they both seem to cover an aspect of crafting. Priests of either deity explain that Torag is involved in creation of items from its raw state, and repair of items that have been broken, particularly military or magical gear. Folgrit, meanwhile, covers maintenance and small fixes, and is usually concerned only with mundane items.

Title The Watchful Mother

Areas of Concern Children, hearths, mothers

Edicts Maintain the sanctity of a home, remain patient with others, take in those without families

Anathema Abandon your family, fail to defend your neighbors

Religious Symbol rune-carved hearth

Sacred Animal young animals

Sacred Colors gray, orange

_desc_ko:
어떤 신화에 따르면 결혼하기 오래전, 폴그리트는 애도자들의 여신이었다고 하며, 대규모 전쟁과 재난 이후 사별로 남겨진 이들을 지켜보고 보호하던 존재였다고 합니다. 그녀는 수많은 드워프들, 특히 고아들이 세상과 드워프 공동체 전체를 상대로 홀로 자신을 지켜야 하는 처지로 내몰리는 것을 목격했습니다. 이들을 추방자의 운명에서 구하기로 결심한 그녀는 당시 독신이던 토라그에게 하나의 제안을 들고 다가갔습니다. 자신과의 혼인을 대가로, 그가 가정과 보호의 권능을 자신과 나누어 달라는 것이었습니다. 이 결합은 만신전에서 크게 경축된 경사였습니다. 합의한 권능을 나누어 주는 것에 더해, 토라그는 폴그리트에게 정착지와 도시를 감독하는 권능도 선사하여, 그녀가 보살피는 이들이 언제나 안식처를 갖도록 할 수 있게 했습니다.

지켜보는 어머니로서 폴그리트의 가르침은 여러 주제를 아우릅니다. 가장 흔한 것은 살림에 관한 실용적인 교훈으로, 청소와 요리에서 수선에 이르기까지 다양한 필수 생활 기술을 다룹니다. 그러므로 그녀의 신전 상당수가 조리법과 설명서, 도구, 조리 기구로 가득한 도서관이나 작업장을 갖추고 있는 것은 드문 일이 아닙니다. 비신도에게는 폴그리트의 관장 영역이 어디서 끝나고 토라그의 영역이 어디서 시작되는지 구분하기 어려울 수 있는데, 둘 다 제작의 한 측면을 다루는 듯 보이기 때문입니다. 두 신 어느 쪽의 사제든 이렇게 설명합니다. 토라그는 원자재 상태에서 물건을 창조하는 일과 부서진 물건, 특히 군사 장비나 마법 장비를 수리하는 일에 관여합니다. 반면 폴그리트는 유지 관리와 사소한 수선을 다루며, 대개 평범한 물건만을 관장합니다.

관장 영역 아이, 화롯가, 어머니

계율 가정의 신성함을 지킬 것, 타인에게 인내심을 유지할 것, 가족 없는 이들을 거둘 것

금기 가족을 저버리는 것, 이웃을 지키지 못하는 것

name: The Path of the Heavens

description.value:
The Path of the Heavens is well known to those who make their way in Golarion. Looking down from above, these deities help travelers and voyagers find their path. Their guidance can be literal, or for others, more spiritual—some worshippers seek to know the progress of Sarenrae (the sun), Tsukiyo (the moon), and Desna (the stars) and through this knowledge gain enlightenment. Nocticula, the last member of the pantheon, for her part uses the cover of the darkness, the gaps in between the others, to shelter travelers and outcasts. Some who worship her as their primary deity in the pantheon seek to use the void between the stars to defend voyagers on the road. Though this is frowned upon by the other members of the Path of the Heavens, it does not seem to disrupt the harmony between the gods.

Edicts guide travelers; observe the movements of the moon, planets, and stars

Anathema mislead a traveler, permanently blind an enemy

Areas of Concern Celestial bodies, navigation, travelers

_desc_ko:
하늘의 길은 골라리온을 여행하는 이들에게 잘 알려져 있습니다. 저 높은 곳에서 내려다보며, 이 신들은 여행자와 항해자가 자신의 길을 찾도록 돕습니다. 그 인도는 말 그대로 길일 수도 있고, 또 어떤 이들에게는 보다 영적인 것이기도 합니다—어떤 숭배자들은 사레나에(태양), 츠키요(달), 데스나(별)의 운행을 알고자 하며, 이 지식을 통해 깨달음을 얻습니다. 만신전의 마지막 일원인 녹티쿨라는 어둠의 장막, 즉 다른 이들 사이의 틈을 이용해 여행자와 추방자를 보호합니다. 그녀를 만신전의 주된 신으로 숭배하는 이들 가운데 일부는 별과 별 사이의 공허를 이용해 길 위의 항해자를 지키고자 합니다. 이는 하늘의 길의 다른 일원들에게 눈살을 찌푸리게 하는 일이지만, 신들 사이의 조화를 흐트러뜨리지는 않는 듯합니다.

교리 여행자를 인도한다; 달과 행성과 별의 운행을 관찰한다

금기 여행자를 잘못된 길로 이끄는 것, 적을 영구히 실명시키는 것

관장 영역 천체, 항법, 여행자

name: Alocer

description.value:
Alocer is a lawful evil diabolic demigod, the infernal duke of beasts, hunters, and tradition. Known also as the Pack Lord, he appears as a fire-breathing, lion-headed, heavily armored archer with eagle talons for feet. His symbol is a dragon-legged horse, said to be a representation of his favored mount.

Edicts hunt those who are capable of thinking for themselves, gather like-minded hunters into groups based in hunting lodges, burn places of worship devoted to Erastil or corrupt those who follow his faith

Anathema sleep in a place sacred to Erastil, willingly harm a lion, grant a merciful death to a creature you have wounded

알로세르는 질서 악 성향의 악마적 반신(半神)으로, 짐승과 사냥꾼과 전통을 관장하는 지옥의 공작입니다. 무리의 군주라고도 불리는 그는 불을 뿜고 사자 머리를 지녔으며 중장갑을 두른 궁수의 모습으로 나타나고, 발은 독수리의 발톱을 하고 있습니다. 그의 상징은 용의 다리를 가진 말로, 그가 아끼는 탈것을 나타낸다고 전해집니다.

교리 스스로 사고할 수 있는 자들을 사냥한다, 뜻이 맞는 사냥꾼들을 사냥 오두막을 거점으로 삼는 무리로 규합한다, 에라스틸을 섬기는 예배 장소를 불태우거나 그의 신앙을 따르는 자들을 타락시킨다

name: Lurlup

description.value:
Not much is known of Lurlup but that he has an endless appetite. Big Eater Brother appears as a typical goblin with dark blue skin and multiple mouths all around his body, such as the ones within his palms and on his lower back. He is a goblin hero-god revered by those who adore eating, though not necessarily because they enjoy the taste of food. Lurlup's followers eat because they enjoy the act of eating, and feel the need to be chewing or having something in their mouth. This means that the two main things they value are a food's texture and temperature. They also find purpose in eating unique things, such as parts from hydras or elementals.

Title Big Eater Brother

Areas of Concern Chefs, feasts, hyperphagia

Edicts Feed upon everything in your surroundings

Anathema Be fussy with your food, choose one meal over another, waste a meal

Religious Symbol dented cleaver

Sacred Animal hippopotamus

Sacred Colors silver, red

_desc_en:
Not much is known of Lurlup but that he has an endless appetite. Big Eater Brother appears as a typical goblin with dark blue skin and multiple mouths all around his body, such as the ones within his palms and on his lower back. He is a goblin hero-god revered by those who adore eating, though not necessarily because they enjoy the taste of food. Lurlup's followers eat because they enjoy the act of eating, and feel the need to be chewing or having something in their mouth. This means that the two main things they value are a food's texture and temperature. They also find purpose in eating unique things, such as parts from hydras or elementals.

Title Big Eater Brother

Areas of Concern Chefs, feasts, hyperphagia

Edicts Feed upon everything in your surroundings

Anathema Be fussy with your food, choose one meal over another, waste a meal

Religious Symbol dented cleaver

Sacred Animal hippopotamus

Sacred Colors silver, red
_desc_ko:
러럽에 대해서는 그가 끝없는 식욕을 지녔다는 것 외에 알려진 바가 많지 않습니다. 대식가 형제는 짙은 파란 피부에 손바닥 안과 등 아래쪽 등 온몸 곳곳에 여러 개의 입이 달린 전형적인 고블린의 모습으로 나타납니다. 그는 먹는 것을 사랑하는 이들이 숭배하는 고블린 영웅신이지만, 반드시 음식의 맛을 즐기기 때문만은 아닙니다. 러럽의 추종자들은 먹는 행위 자체를 즐기기에 먹으며, 무언가를 씹거나 입에 넣고 있어야 한다는 충동을 느낍니다. 그래서 그들이 중요하게 여기는 두 가지는 음식의 질감과 온도입니다. 또한 히드라나 정령의 일부처럼 독특한 것을 먹는 데에서 삶의 목적을 찾기도 합니다.

칭호 대식가 형제

관장 영역 요리사, 잔치, 과식증

교리 주변에 있는 모든 것을 먹어 치운다

금기 음식에 까다롭게 구는 것, 한 끼를 다른 끼니보다 골라 먹는 것, 한 끼를 낭비하는 것

종교 상징 이가 빠진 식칼

name: Seafarers' Hope

description.value:
This pantheon originated in the Shackles for perhaps obvious reasons, but its worshippers now spread along most every coastline in the Inner Sea, so don't imagine that this pantheon is just for pirates or the less savory types in the import business-though it certainly appeals to them, too. The flashier deities in this pantheon are the better known, for who doesn't associate Besmara, the Pirate Queen, with her swashbuckling antics and Hei Feng, the Duke of Thunder, with the storms survivors still speak of years later? Yet the duality of Gozreh and the sustainability and care of Ylimancha round out this pantheon. The Wind and the Waves and the Harborwing strive for safety and balance between air, land, and sea, and it's for their care that many a frightened, stormtossed seafarer prays during a perilous journey. Followers of this pantheon aren't given to regular worship unless to utter a simple prayer or recitation on the bow of a ship at sea. Instead, the faithful find themselves most pious when the winds, waves, and thunder are in full force, threatening the survival of the ship, or when they pull into harbor after safely enduring a storm. At such times, joyous celebrations of dancing, singing, and pouring out libations to their gods mark their worship. Faithful followers are also committed to rescuing those at sea and have been known to sail into terrifying storms in search of the stranded.

Edicts give thanks for safe passage, respect the sea, view all storms with optimism and perseverance

Anathema put off travel until there are calm waters, refuse aid to those stranded at sea, stay too long on land

Areas of Concern coastlines, the sea, seafarers, storms

_desc_ko:
이 만신전은 아마도 뻔한 이유로 셰클스에서 유래했지만, 그 숭배자들은 이제 내해의 거의 모든 해안선을 따라 퍼져 있으니, 이 만신전이 그저 해적이나 수입업에 종사하는 덜 점잖은 부류만을 위한 것이라고 여기지는 마십시오—물론 그들에게도 분명 매력적이긴 합니다. 이 만신전에서 더 화려한 신들이 더 잘 알려져 있는데, 해적 여왕 베스마라의 활극과, 살아남은 자들이 몇 년이 지나도 회자하는 폭풍우를 몰고 오는 천둥의 공작 헤이 펭을 누가 떠올리지 않겠습니까? 그러나 고즈레의 이중성과 일리만차의 지속가능성 및 돌봄이 이 만신전을 완성합니다. 바람과 파도, 그리고 항구의 날개는 하늘과 땅과 바다 사이의 안전과 균형을 위해 애쓰며, 위험한 항해 중에 겁에 질려 폭풍에 시달리는 수많은 선원이 바로 이들의 보살핌을 기원합니다. 이 만신전의 추종자들은 바다 위 배의 뱃머리에서 간단한 기도나 낭송을 읊는 것 외에는 정기적인 예배를 드리지 않습니다. 대신 신실한 이들은 바람과 파도와 천둥이 온 힘을 다해 배의 생존을 위협할 때, 혹은 폭풍을 무사히 견뎌내고 항구에 들어올 때 가장 경건해집니다. 그런 순간에 그들은 춤추고 노래하며 신들에게 술을 바치는 기쁨의 축제로 예배를 올립니다. 신실한 추종자들은 또한 바다에서 조난당한 이들을 구조하는 데 헌신하며, 표류하는 이들을 찾아 무시무시한 폭풍 속으로 항해해 들어가기도 한다고 알려져 있습니다.

교리 무사한 항해에 감사한다, 바다를 존중한다, 모든 폭풍을 낙관과 끈기로 바라본다

금기 잔잔한 바다가 될 때까지 항해를 미루는 것, 바다에서 조난당한 이들에게 도움을 거절하는 것, 육지에 너무 오래 머무는 것

관장 영역 해안선, 바다, 선원, 폭풍

name: Nergal

description.value:
Preceded by the stench of sun-ripened corpses, one is never caught unawares by Nergal. The sights of the battlefield, driving many mortals to teary eyes and corkscrewed mouths holding back retches, stir him with giddy laughter from his many orifices. Classically, the Slow Death has invested in the ways and means of war, nurturing death on a nation-state scale. Bodies of the dead were left on the ground, but also walking back to their homes to spread invisible death. Recently, Nergal and his sycophants have taken an interest in the sciences. Sowing doubt and misinformation among physicians and patients alike, they wrench rifts ever wider between those who would champion against infection and rot.

Title The Slow Death

Areas of Concern Atrocity, pestilence, war

Edicts Consume fungus and fermented or germinated foods, mutilate the dead, spread sickness

Anathema Deliberately smell a benign flower, use soap, burn or cremate the dead

Religious Symbol sun rising over battlefield

Sacred Animal jackal

Sacred Colors black, tan

_desc_ko:
햇볕에 무르익은 시체의 악취를 앞세우고 오기에, 그 누구도 네르갈에게 불시에 당하는 일은 없습니다. 수많은 필멸자들이 눈물을 흘리고 구역질을 참느라 입을 비틀게 만드는 전장의 광경은, 그의 온몸에 난 수많은 구멍에서 터져 나오는 들뜬 웃음을 자아냅니다. 전통적으로 느린 죽음은 전쟁의 방법과 수단에 힘을 쏟아, 국가 규모로 죽음을 길러 왔습니다. 죽은 자들의 시신은 땅에 버려지기도 했지만, 제 발로 집으로 걸어 돌아가 보이지 않는 죽음을 퍼뜨리기도 했습니다. 최근 네르갈과 그 아첨꾼들은 과학에 관심을 갖게 되었습니다. 의사와 환자 모두에게 의심과 잘못된 정보를 퍼뜨리며, 감염과 부패에 맞서 싸우려는 이들 사이의 틈을 점점 더 크게 벌려 놓습니다.

칭호 느린 죽음

관장 영역 잔학 행위, 역병, 전쟁

교리 곰팡이와 발효되거나 발아한 음식을 먹는다, 시신을 훼손한다, 병을 퍼뜨린다

금기 무해한 꽃의 향기를 일부러 맡는 것, 비누를 사용하는 것, 시신을 불태우거나 화장하는 것

name: Imbrex

description.value:
Known as the Twins, Imbrex is the mysterious Eldest of twins, statues, and endings. Appearing as two immense stone statues hundreds of feet tall holding hands and looking outward, Imbrex neither moves nor speaks. The Eldest sometimes communicates with telepathic utterances that rend minds or deliver psychic enlightenment, but they more often express their will through startlingly realistic dreams that sometimes manifest into strange life. An entire city named Anophaeus sprawls at Imbrex's four feet, populated by jaded urbanites, eager aspirants, and prowling dreamcreatures made real. An unusually high proportion of those born in Anophaeus are twins, and twins are also common among Imbrex's worshippers. Although Imbrex appears timeless in form, they are intrigued by dramatic endings, particularly apocalypses, and have foreknowledge of disasters to come.

Title The Twins

Areas of Concern Endings, statues, twins

Edicts Pursue your own goals, bring things to their proper ending, split things in half or otherwise create pairs

Anathema Offend Imbrex

Religious Symbol clasped hands

Sacred Animal hibernating animals

Sacred Colors gray, silver

_desc_ko:
쌍둥이라 불리는 임브렉스는 쌍둥이와 조각상과 종말을 관장하는 신비로운 태초의 존재입니다. 손을 맞잡고 바깥을 바라보는, 수백 피트 높이의 거대한 두 석상의 모습으로 나타나는 임브렉스는 움직이지도 말하지도 않습니다. 이 태초의 존재는 이따금 정신을 찢어놓거나 정신적 깨달음을 전하는 텔레파시의 발화로 소통하기도 하지만, 그보다 더 자주 놀랄 만큼 생생한 꿈을 통해 자신의 뜻을 표현하며, 그 꿈은 때때로 기이한 생명으로 발현되기도 합니다. 아노파에우스라는 이름의 도시 전체가 임브렉스의 네 발치에 펼쳐져 있으며, 무기력한 도시민들과 열망에 찬 지망자들, 그리고 현실이 된 배회하는 꿈짐승들이 그곳을 채우고 있습니다. 아노파에우스에서 태어난 이들 가운데 쌍둥이의 비율이 유난히 높으며, 임브렉스의 숭배자들 중에도 쌍둥이가 흔합니다. 임브렉스는 그 형상이 시간을 초월한 듯 보이지만, 극적인 종말, 특히 종말론적 파국에 매료되어 있으며 다가올 재앙을 미리 알고 있습니다.

칭호 쌍둥이

관장 영역 종말, 조각상, 쌍둥이

교리 자신의 목표를 좇는다, 사물을 마땅한 끝에 이르게 한다, 사물을 반으로 가르거나 짝을 이루게 만든다

금기 임브렉스를 모독하는 것

종교 상징 맞잡은 두 손

신성한 동물 겨울잠을 자는 동물

신성한 색 회색, 은색

name: Pulura

description.value:
Dancing through the northern sky, the Shimmering Maiden represents constellations, homesickness, and the northern lights. Pulura understands that the constellations are the guide with which mortals navigate their world, lighting the way so that those who travel or explore can always find their way home. The stories of the constellations not only entertain with tales of goodness and light and strength, but they are also a tool for helping others learn and remember the stars. This ensures that the map in the sky is easy to read and never forgotten. To learn this map and to guide those who are lost or otherwise in need of direction are exceptional callings, but even more so is to teach a petitioner to navigate the skies themself on the journey.

Title The Shimmering Maiden

Areas of Concern Constellations, homesickness, northern lights

Edicts Aid travelers, comfort the lonely, teach the constellations

Anathema Mock the homesick, deny warmth to others, pollute the skies with smoke or light

Religious Symbol face in northern lights

Sacred Animal firefly

Sacred Colors midnight blue

_desc_ko:
북쪽 하늘을 춤추듯 가로지르는 반짝이는 처녀는 별자리와 향수(鄕愁), 그리고 오로라를 상징합니다. 푸룰라는 별자리가 필멸자들이 자신의 세계를 항해하는 길잡이이며, 여행하거나 탐험하는 이들이 언제나 집으로 돌아가는 길을 찾을 수 있도록 앞길을 비춘다는 것을 이해합니다. 별자리의 이야기는 선함과 빛과 힘의 설화로 즐거움을 줄 뿐만 아니라, 다른 이들이 별을 배우고 기억하도록 돕는 도구이기도 합니다. 이로써 하늘의 지도는 읽기 쉽고 결코 잊히지 않게 됩니다. 이 지도를 익히고 길을 잃었거나 방향이 필요한 이들을 인도하는 것은 특별한 소명이지만, 여정 중에 있는 청원자에게 스스로 하늘을 항해하는 법을 가르치는 것은 그보다 더욱 특별한 소명입니다.

칭호 반짝이는 처녀

관장 영역 별자리, 향수, 오로라

교리 여행자를 돕는다, 외로운 이를 위로한다, 별자리를 가르친다

금기 향수병에 걸린 이를 조롱하는 것, 다른 이에게 온기를 베풀기를 거부하는 것, 연기나 빛으로 하늘을 오염시키는 것

종교 상징 오로라 속의 얼굴

신성한 동물 반딧불이

신성한 색 심야의 파랑

name: Monad

description.value:
All aeons come from, return to, are connected with, and are guided by the Monad. The Condition of All is not a deity in the traditional sense. It exists both within and outside the multiverse and has influence over the entirety of existence. Though generally content to allow the multiverse to run its course, the Monad directs its aeons to intervene when events deviate from their ineffable design. Mortal scholars often personify the Monad as the deity of creation, the infinite, and truth. Even so, few worship it, and the Monad pays very little attention to mortal petitioners. Instead, scholars study and plot aeons' actions, striving to discern the Monad's ultimate goal or to uncover universal truths they can exploit for their own purposes. Only a rare few mortals can master the asceticism necessary to connect with the Monad, gaining hidden knowledge and powers akin to those of other divine spellcasters. While the Monad seems to be more than capable of maintaining the sanctity of existence, the fact that it broke off pieces of itself to create the first arbitrators suggests the Monad is either fully incapable of doing so alone or is choosing to focus its attention toward other matters.

Title The Condition of All

Areas of Concern Creation, the infinite, truth

Edicts Ensure balance between opposing forces, mediate disagreements

Anathema Allow your personal motivations to determine a major decision

Religious Symbol spiral galaxy

Sacred Animal trilobite

Sacred Colors black, white

While the Monad seems to be more than capable of maintaining the sanctity of existence, the fact that it broke off pieces of itself to create the first arbitrators suggests the Monad is either fully incapable of doing so alone or is choosing to focus its attention toward other matters.

description.value:
All mortals must die. This is the empirical truth championed by Chamiaholom, whose mission is to remind mortals that they will one day meet their end. Chamiaholom's form is a towering skeleton over 14 feet tall, wielding a staff made from the skulls of his victims. He is sometimes glimpsed around sites of tragedy and destruction and stalks those who've survived near-death experiences, terrifying witnesses who mistake him for death incarnate. Chamiaholom's followers wear dark paint on their faces to imitate the tormentor's skeletal visage as they travel around Golarion preaching their message of despair.

Title Skull Staff

Areas of Concern Domination, hopelessness, mortality

Edicts Accept the futility of life, destroy sentient undead, punish those who somehow avoid death

Anathema Comfort the dying, seek immortality or unnatural longevity

Religious Symbol staff made of skulls

name: Geryon

description.value:
Once the mightiest of asura ranas, Geryon betrayed hundreds of Hell's original asura inhabitants to aid Asmodeus in claiming the plane, in the process earning himself the title the Source of Lies. His realm of Stygia, Hell's fifth layer, hews most closely to the nature of Hell before Asmodeus reshaped the plane, and it contains the sunken ruins of countless cities and libraries predating the war against Heaven. The archdevil hoards knowledge and secrets especially that which has been forbidden—while spreading falsehoods and heresies to mislead the ignorant, and his followers revel in the same.

Title The Serpent, Source of Lies

Areas of Concern Forbidden knowledge, heresy, snakes

Edicts Hoard knowledge, test the boundaries of taboo, spread falsehoods to dupe the foolhardy

Anathema Declare knowledge heresy or forbidden, break your word

name: Sangpotshi

description.value:
The philosophy of Sangpotshi, also known as the River of Life, centers around concepts of fate, karma, and cyclic reincarnation. Adherents believe each soul is judged upon its actions in life, and these actions determine its station when it returns to the living world. This cycle repeats until the soul reaches its perfected form through the accrual of experience and wisdom, whereupon it passes on to Pharasma's court and the afterlife to come.

Edicts live selflessly; heed the wisdom of the learned, the wise, and those in stations of authority

Anathema needlessly break significant traditions, actively interfere with the perfection efforts of another soul or allow others to do so

Areas of Concern fate, karma, and reincarnation

Hastur is a Great Old One who, though confined to the city of Carcosa on a planet orbiting a faraway star, is nevertheless in the midst of a transformation into a true Outer God. name: The Pandemonia

description.value:
Some people just want to throw the world into chaos, whether on a smaller scale through vexing pranks or on a larger scale by embracing complete anarchy. Adherents to the Pandemonia venerate the most confounding of extraplanar entities, ones who refuse to be bound by order and decorum to do whatever they want whenever they want. Some claim that their acts are all in good fun, but they often don't take the feelings of those they trick into account. Others know full well the consequences of their actions and simply don't care who they hurt. As befitting such a chaotic covenant, there is hardly any conformity of beliefs or methods within its ranks, making it almost more of a philosophy (albeit a rather disorganized one) than anything else.

name: Diomazul

description.value:
An obscure Vudran god of war, Diomazul, the Serpent of Eighty Blades, is a patron of ascetic meditation, bitter renewals, and inordinate retribution. Devotees and theologians speak of Diomazul as having the likeness of a massive, hooded cobra in serene slumber—80 arms folded in stillness comprise this hood, each hand grasping a sheathed blade. When roused to violence by enemies, Diomazul awakens, retaining his tranquil countenance, but his hood flares in a bristle of steel as he draws all 80 blades to welcome his newfound foes and offer a gift of their unmaking. Once the Serpent of Eighty Blades has concluded evicting the life from his enemies, he entwines his body around their remains, crushing their bones into the earth and scattering their blood into the waters, burying all spoor of their existence under his immense form.

As these depictions might suggest, Diomazul is a deity of dualistic, seemingly contradictory impulses who unifies the dichotomies of restraint and devastation within his being. Diomazul is a teacher of forbearance and detached contemplation, a paragon of indifference to personal contentment or suffering who meditates upon the universe, sloughing off whatever pain it can visit upon oneself. At the same time, Diomazul also embodies an endless, pitiless resolve to visit frightful destruction upon those who set themselves in opposition to him; once stirred from his reverie by insult or injury, vast and swift reprisal are sure to follow.

In many ways, the Serpent of Eighty Blades is exactly like his name suggests, a coiled being of muscle and killing intent in absolute control of razor-sharp steel. Diomazul's blades split time into two unequal halves for his enemies: the impermanence of existence before meeting him and the decidedly much shorter impermanence of existence after raising his ire.

Title The Serpent of Eighty Blades

Areas of Concern Austerity, retribution, war

Edicts Erase all traces of defeated foes, meditate, remain celibate and detached from worldly pleasures, utterly destroy your enemies

Anathema Give mercy to any who provoke a fight with you, provoke a fight

Religious Symbol cobra hood

Sacred Animal cobra

Sacred Colors black, orange

잘 알려지지 않은 부드라의 전쟁 신인 디오마줄, 여든 자루 검의 뱀은 금욕적 명상, 쓰라린 재생, 그리고 도를 넘는 응보의 수호자입니다. 신자들과 신학자들은 디오마줄이 고요히 잠든 거대한 두건 코브라의 모습을 하고 있다고 말합니다. 이 두건은 미동 없이 접힌 여든 개의 팔로 이루어져 있으며, 각각의 손은 칼집에 든 검을 쥐고 있습니다. 적들에 의해 폭력으로 깨어날 때, 디오마줄은 눈을 뜨면서도 그 평온한 표정을 유지하지만, 여든 자루의 검을 모두 뽑아 새로 나타난 원수들을 맞이하며 그들에게 소멸의 선물을 안길 때 그의 두건은 강철의 곤두섬으로 활짝 펼쳐집니다. 여든 자루 검의 뱀이 적들에게서 생명을 몰아내는 일을 마치면, 그는 자신의 몸으로 그들의 잔해를 휘감아 뼈를 땅속으로 으스러뜨리고 피를 물속으로 흩뿌려, 그들이 존재했던 모든 흔적을 자신의 거대한 형체 아래 묻어 버립니다.

이러한 묘사가 시사하듯, 디오마줄은 이원적이고 겉보기에 모순되는 충동을 지닌 신으로, 절제와 파괴라는 양극단을 자기 존재 안에서 하나로 아우릅니다. 디오마줄은 인내와 초연한 성찰의 스승이며, 개인적 만족이나 고통에 무심한 귀감으로서 우주를 명상하며 우주가 자신에게 가할 수 있는 그 어떤 고통도 떨쳐 냅니다. 이와 동시에 디오마줄은 자신에게 맞서는 자들에게 끔찍한 파멸을 안기려는 끝없고 무자비한 결의 또한 구현합니다. 모욕이나 상처로 한번 명상에서 깨어나면, 광대하고 신속한 보복이 반드시 뒤따릅니다.

여러모로 여든 자루 검의 뱀은 그 이름이 시사하는 그대로, 면도날처럼 날카로운 강철을 완벽히 통제하는, 근육과 살의로 똬리를 튼 존재입니다. 디오마줄의 검은 그의 적들에게 시간을 두 개의 불균등한 반쪽으로 갈라놓습니다. 그를 만나기 전 존재의 덧없음과, 그의 분노를 산 이후의 훨씬 더 짧은 존재의 덧없음으로 말입니다.

name: Acavna

description.value:
Acavna, the Shield, was one of humanity's fiercest protectors. Legends of her tactics and exploits spanned the entirety of the Azlanti Empire. Her most famous act of heroism led to her death during the events of Earthfall. Determined to protect her people, Acavna refused to stand down despite her partner Amaznen's pleas. She used her magic to move Golarion's moon in the way of the incoming meteor, absorbing most of the destructive blast. Her body fell from the sky and plunged into the planet's core. The Mordant Spire grew from her remains, and the elves who reside there claim to hear Acavna whispering to them.

name: Ragadahn

description.value:
As boastful as he is bestial, Ragadahn the Water Lord is the Eldest of oceans, linnorms, and sinuous spirals. He appears as a great serpentine dragon in the First World's seas, but he is widely traveled and takes other forms as needed to pursue both martial conquests and amorous affairs. He is widely believed to be the progenitor of all linnorms, and he claims to be the progenitor of all dragons. True dragons stridently contest this assertion, although they wisely decline to do so when in Ragadahn's majestic presence. Failure to deliver proper respect to the arrogant Ragadahn invites his legendary ire, and no supplicant can ever be too flattering for his tastes. Yet for all his tempestuous nature, he is wise, and he holds much otherwise lost and forgotten knowledge.

Title The Water Lord

Areas of Concern Linnorms, oceans, spirals

Edicts Draw spirals, seek primordial secrets, use poison, always carry water

Anathema Suffer a linnorm's death curse, destroy a fossil

name: Dajermube

description.value:
Dajermube was once a mortal woman who led the rebellion against Mzali's Council of Mwanyisa when they tried to wipe out the worship of the Old Sun Gods. She was a descendant of the god Chohar, and divine power flowed through her veins. To help her people protect the knowledge of those deities, she attempted to ascend to godhood in the Temple of the Eclipse. Her ritual was interrupted as it reached its climax, and she was struck down by a crossbow bolt before the transformation was completed. As a result, she spent tormented centuries trapped between life and death until heroes freed the Temple of the Eclipse and enabled her apotheosis to resume.

Title Holder of Unquenchable Light

Areas Of Concern journeys, self-realization, shadows

Edicts push toward your own goals by striking your own path, try to help others achieve their goals when asked, draw upon all your resources

Anathema intentionally keep others from achieving honorable goals, support others to the exclusion of yourself or vice versa, use shadows to harm innocents
